json_proto.name: CLINICAL_CLAIMS_SV

queries.correspondingQuestion: What is the total claim cost and payer coverage ratio by payer?
queries.sqlText: SELECT p.PAYER_NAME, SUM(e.TOTAL_CLAIM_COST) AS TOTAL_CLAIM_COST, SUM(e.PAYER_COVERAGE) / NULLIF(SUM(e.TOTAL_CLAIM_COST),0) AS COVERAGE_RATIO FROM CLINICAL_CLAIMS_DV.MARTS.FCT_ENCOUNTER e JOIN CLINICAL_CLAIMS_DV.MARTS.DIM_PAYER p ON p.PAYER_ID = e.PAYER_ID GROUP BY p.PAYER_NAME ORDER BY TOTAL_CLAIM_COST DESC

queries.correspondingQuestion: What are the top 10 most common active conditions?
queries.sqlText: SELECT CONDITION_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(DISTINCT PATIENT_ID) AS PATIENTS FROM CLINICAL_CLAIMS_DV.MARTS.FCT_CONDITION WHERE IS_ACTIVE GROUP BY CONDITION_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY PATIENTS DESC LIMIT 10

queries.correspondingQuestion: How many encounters per patient by age band?
queries.sqlText: SELECT d.AGE_BAND, COUNT(e.ENCOUNTER_ID) / COUNT(DISTINCT e.PATIENT_ID) AS ENCOUNTERS_PER_PATIENT FROM CLINICAL_CLAIMS_DV.MARTS.FCT_ENCOUNTER e JOIN CLINICAL_CLAIMS_DV.MARTS.DIM_PATIENT d ON d.PATIENT_ID = e.PATIENT_ID GROUP BY d.AGE_BAND ORDER BY d.AGE_BAND

queries.correspondingQuestion: What is the total outstanding claim balance by month for the last 12 months?
queries.sqlText: SELECT SERVICE_MONTH, SUM(TOTAL_OUTSTANDING) AS OUTSTANDING_BALANCE FROM CLINICAL_CLAIMS_DV.MARTS.FCT_CLAIM WHERE SERVICE_MONTH >= DATEADD(month, -12, DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE())) GROUP BY SERVICE_MONTH ORDER BY SERVICE_MONTH

queries.correspondingQuestion: Which provider specialties have the highest average encounter cost?
queries.sqlText: SELECT pr.SPECIALTY, AVG(e.TOTAL_CLAIM_COST) AS AVG_ENCOUNTER_COST, COUNT(*) AS ENCOUNTERS FROM CLINICAL_CLAIMS_DV.MARTS.FCT_ENCOUNTER e JOIN CLINICAL_CLAIMS_DV.MARTS.DIM_PROVIDER pr ON pr.PROVIDER_ID = e.PROVIDER_ID GROUP BY pr.SPECIALTY ORDER BY AVG_ENCOUNTER_COST DESC

json_proto.semanticDescription: Clinical and claims analytics for a synthetic US healthcare population (Synthea): patients, providers, payers, encounters, claims and diagnosed conditions. Built from the CLINICAL_CLAIMS_DV Data Vault marts. Patient direct identifiers are excluded.
